verdict.rationale: Gusto Embedded Payroll offers a fully documented public REST API with authentication, pagination, idempotency, versioning, webhooks, official client libraries, and a React SDK, plus reference docs for concrete endpoints (contractor payments, time off, payroll). This gives AI-native developers a rich, well-documented surface to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on third-party verification of API robustness beyond vendor docs.
